rationale: Artem brings deep ML systems expertise in efficient inference and transformer architectures from Nous Research, while Nathan is building next-generation AI systems at Extropic grounded in physical principles and hardware-software co-design. Both work in PyTorch-based ML research with complementary perspectives—Artem's hands-on infrastructure focus (loopvlm, model optimization) could directly support Nathan's embodied AI and probabilistic methods work, and Nathan's conviction around physical grounding and real-world data aligns well with exploring practical applications of Artem's inference optimization.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Nathan Yu — both are building the next layer of AI systems where efficient inference and real-world embodiment matter, and your ML infrastructure expertise could be valuable to Extropic's work on physics-informed learning.
